name: Cloud browser
summary: The agent gets its own browser running on a server, with a profile that keeps cookies and logins between runs. It works while the user's laptop is closed, and the user can watch or take over through a live view.
how: Provision a hosted browser session for the agent
Save cookies and storage to a reusable profile
Agent drives it over CDP, Playwright or a computer-use loop
User logs in or approves steps through a live view when needed
facts: Browserbase, Browser Use Cloud, Hyperbrowser, Steel
Reusable profiles keep logins across sessions
Always available, but you hand session cookies to a vendor
goodFor: Keeping agent logins apart from personal ones
watchOut: Sites may block datacenter IPs and headless browsers
